title: RHYTHMIC SAMPLER -- eight sample slots, each with its own sliced step sequence

sections.heading: USING IT
lines: Audio On/Off: starts audio. PLAY: starts all slots. BPM: master tempo (default 120).
Each slot: LOAD SOUND opens a file. The waveform shows it with a playhead.
STEPS: how many slices the sound is cut into; it is also the pattern length (up to 16).
Each step plays the matching slice, one step per 16th note.
Step Pattern: bar height = velocity for that step. A bar at 0 turns the step off.
Start: shifts where slicing begins within the sound.
Pitch (+/-1200 cents), Cutoff, Reso and Type (LP, HP, BP, Notch): pitch and filter.
Degrd: sample-rate reduction. Atk / Dec: envelope for each step. Vol: slot level.
MUTE silences the slot. BPM OVRD: run this slot at its own tempo instead of the master.
MASTER: final level fader and meter.

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: Each slot is slot.maxpat loaded as a bpatcher with a buffer name and a send~ name.
slot-engine.js works out each slice's start and end; groove~ plays that range.
Chain per slot: groove~ > svf~ filter > degrade~ > envelope > volume > send~.
The main patch sums all eight slots (mono) and sends them to both outputs.
